The following events took place in '''25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] retired.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*Remnants of the [[Second Imperium]] were defeated.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historical Council]] published ''[[The Essential Chronology]]''.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>
*Establishment of the [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|'ABY-BBY' dating system]].<ref name="TEC" />
*60:2&ndash;[[Wurth Skidder]] arrived on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Mediator (Mediator-class)|''Mediator'']], the New Republic staging point between two opposing planets of the [[Osarian-Rhommamool conflict]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ackdool]] was pleased with the arrival of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], due to rumors of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attempts against his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="VP" />
*[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] escaped the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and returned to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to complete his [[Sith training]] under [[XoXaan]].
*A team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at the [[ExGal-4]] outpost on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] was wiped out by Yuuzhan Vong advance agents, with the sole exception of [[Danni Quee]].<ref name="VP" />
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] begins.
*The New Republic began to lose to the Yuuzhan Vong War.
*[[Destruction of Sernpidal]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dobido]], by the [[Praetorite Vong]].
*The [[Death/Legends|Death]] of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] during [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal's]] destruction.
*[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] entered into [[Kaleesh/Legends|his species]]' religious pantheon.<ref name="StoryofGG">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>
